verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with a substantial official software ecosystem (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Spur scheduler), so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server for connecting agents. The llms.txt file is an adjacent docs-for-LLMs feature, not an MCP server, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
